Due to the addition of a broadcasting aerial at the top of the tower in 1957, it is now taller than the Chrysler Building by 5.2 metres (17 ft). Tickets can be purchased to ascend by stairs or lift to the first and second levels. Hunt's pedestal design contains elements of classical architecture, including Doric portals, as well as some elements influenced by Aztec architecture.[33] The large mass is fragmented with architectural detail, in order to focus attention on the statue.[79] In form, it is a truncated pyramid, 62 feet (19 m) square at the base and 39.4 feet (12.0 m) at the top. description_text:
Street props modeled in Blender, and textured with Substance Painter.
These models were created with high quality rendered images in mind, but can also be used for games or other projects. If you intend to use it in a game engine, please be advised that you may have to do some reduction in polygon count, depending on your needs.
Textures that come with these model are: base_color, roughness, metallic, and a normal map (openGL). All textures come in 4K resolution, so you can scale them down safely in any photo editing software, if you need lower resolution. For better resolution of the textures, some models use more than one material. Some models come with multiple color textures for you to diversify your scene.If using with a game engine, it is recommended that you channel pack the textures for saving memory usage.
If you're having any issues or questions with these models, or you need something changed, feel free to contact me any time.
Thank you for your purchase.

description_text:
Accurate 3d model of the blood vessels of the brain.The Circle of Willis (also called Willis' Circle, Loop of Willis, cerebral arterial circle, and Willis Polygon) is a circulatory anastomosis that supplies blood to the brain and surrounding structures. It is named after Thomas Willis (1621–1675), an English physician.
The Circle of Willis is a part of the cerebral circulation and is composed of the following arteries:
    Anterior cerebral artery (left and right)    Anterior communicating artery    Internal carotid artery (left and right)    Posterior cerebral artery (left and right)    Posterior communicating artery (left and right)    Basilar artery
The middle cerebral arteries, supplying the brain, are not considered part of the circle.

Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 Gedung BRI II is a 32-storey (143m/469ft) office tower in Jakarta. BRI head office. Was completed in 1991. The design evolves from a large, efficient square floor plate of 2,750sqm, enclosing a two-zone, 10 lift core. The floor plate is designed to flexibly and economically accommodate the requirements of corporate tenants. The craftsmanship has been carefully refined through the careful detailing of the space which provides a polished corporate ambience second to none in the city. The exterior design is generated from the square plan and is based on the principles of a free standing point tower with a solid base, or podium, supporting a column, or tower, of reflective glass topped with a square, symmetrically arranged pyramidal top. The base of the building follows the footprint of the tower floors above and is clad in polished Argentinean granite. A lightness in design at the base, along with a separation of the base from the tower, was achieved by subtly composing the dark and light coloured granites with clear glass around the two storey banking halls at the ground level. The tower is clad in blue reflective glass on 1.8m by 1.8m grid reflecting the regular and efficient floor plan of the building.

Millbank Tower is a 118-meter high skyscraper in the City of Westminster at Millbank, by the River Thames in London. it was designed by the architect Ronald Ward and construction started in 1959, the building consists of a main tower mounted on an elevated base with support columns, the base has a pizza express restaurant and a second smaller tower. although the building was constructed in London it is obscure enough to be used in any city without a second glance.

description_text:
The famous but controversial Lady of Elx (Dama de Elche in Spanish) is a polychrome stone bust that was revealed as found by chance in 1897 at L'Alcśdia, an archaeological site that was on a private estate about 2 km, south of Elx (Spanish Elche) (Alicante, Valencia, Spain). The Lady of Elx is generally believed to be an Iberian piece of the 4th century B.C. yet showing strong Hellenistic influences.
Product Features:
The product contains three resolutions of the model, and it is textured.
This model is a 3DMax model, saved in version 8 as a MAX file, and requires 3DMax. It does not include any other formats to allow it to be opened in any other software. The model is mapped and textured.

description_text:
Ancient Stone Well for games with PBR textures. This type of ancient stone well is often found in medieval scenes, villages and so forth.
Real world metric scale confirmed in .uasset .fbx and .blend formats. The model snaps into the grid. The ground plane is 6x6meter. The model is ready to import to any game engine that supports physically based materials.
The model has custom mesh normals, no baked normal data was used. Mostly quads model with 1,154 faces (2,184 when converted to tris) and 1,362 verts. No co-planar faces, isolated vertices or n-gons. 
The ground has it's own separate UVs, material and textures. The well has tightly packed non-overlapping UVs. The ground is it's separate objects and the vertices are not welded to the well.
Textures high resolution metal-rough PBR textures and are saved losslessly in 4K resolution .PNG format. They are in RGB packed format BaseColor, Normal and Occlusion+Roughness+Metal for efficiency.
The model comes with game ready .fbx file and textures in separate .zip package as render ready Blender Cycles scene and also ready to render Marmoset Toolbag Scene. Unreal Engine .uasset files are ready to be used in game projects.

description_text:
Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana is an icon of Fascist architecture. Decidedly inspired by the 2000 year old elliptical amphitheatre, the Colosseum, Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana was intended by Benito Mussolini as a celebration of the older Roman landmark. The Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana, also known as the Palazzo della Civiltà del Lavoro or simply the Colosseo Quadrato (Square Colosseum), is an icon of Fascist architecture.
The building was designed in 1937 to host the Mostra della Civiltà Romana during the 1942 World Fair by Italian architects Giovanni Guerrini, Ernesto Bruno La Padula  and Mario Romano.
It lies in the district of Rome known as the Esposizione Universale Roma (also known as 'E.42' and 'EUR'). It is particularly symbolic of this district, exemplifying its monumentality.
The palace is entirely clad in travertine marble, as is characteristic of buildings in the EUR. It is a parallelepiped on a square base, with six levels rising above a podium. The scale is imposing: the base covers an area of 8,400 square meters, and the building has volume 205,000 cubic meters with a height 68 meters.
Because of its bold appearance and iconic status, the building has appeared in a number of films, including The Last Man on Earth, Hudson Hawk, Titus and Equilibrium.
From October 22, 2015 this monument has become the new headquarter of the famous fashion brand Fendi. 
Enjoy

Low-poly PBR Pillory model intended for game/realtime/background use.

  - PBR Maps:BaseColor, AO, Roughness, Metalness, Normal, Glossiness, Specular. 

  - Unity maps (+HDRP maps):Diffuse, Normal map, MetallicSmoothness,HDRP mask map.

  - 
Unreal Engine 4 maps:BaseColor, Normal, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic.

Rendering in Marmoset 4, Unreal Engine 4.25, Unity 2020

description_text:
Roman Stone Chair for games and realtime applications with PBR textures. 
This model was created by sculpting and then by manual retopology and baking textures. 
Geometry:Tris only (2740 tris). No co-planar faces or isolated vertices. This model is one seamless mesh. FBX file has real world scale.
UVs:Non overlapping optimized (packed) UV islands. FBX file has a second UV channel for lightmaps. This was tested in Unreal Engine 4.
Textures:Metal-Rough PBR textures in 2048x2048 resolution (.png).
Important:The baking was done in Substance Painter. Please pay attention to the normal format. There is y-flipped normal map included.
If this model is to be used in Unreal Engine 4, please use the included FBX file as it has correct real world scale.
I have also the high resolution model. If you need it for 3D printing or other uses, please contact me.

description_text:
Johannes Brahms 7 May 1833 – 3 April 1897 was a German composer and pianist of the Romantic period. Born in Hamburg into a Lutheran family, Brahms spent much of his professional life in Vienna, Austria. His reputation and status as a composer is such that he is sometimes grouped with Johann Sebastian Bach and Ludwig van Beethoven as one of the Three Bs of music.Brahms composed for symphony orchestra, chamber ensembles, piano, organ, and voice and chorus. A virtuoso pianist, he premiered many of his own works.He worked with some of the leading performers of his time.
Textured and render with 3D Studio MAx 8 and Mental Ray
textures and materials are included into each archive, just unzip and render.
Available in following format: Obj, Max8,Fbx,Stl
The model is print ready. Size : 6,4x 7,5 x 11,9 cm

description_text:
A French-made bolt action rifle, seen by some as one of the most important rifles ever made. It's tube fed so the original ammunition was rounded, however later they adopted pointed bullets due to their various advantages. Having pointed objects right up against the primer of a bullet isn't the best idea so they added an extra ridge to catch the tip of the next round as it's fed in.

High resolution textures exported out of Substance Painter for Unreal Engine and Unity as well as additional maps for anything else. You can downscale the textures if you want, but you'll be receiving 4k resolution.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Iowa Class Battleship model. Certain elements not to scale.
The Iowa class of battleships were the final class of battleships built for the US Navy. As they were no longer bound by the Washington Naval Treaty, the designers were able to make it longer, heavier and carry more armament.  All Iowa-class battleships survive as museum ships, though none of them are in their WWII configuration since they were refit at various times after the war.  Their main armament were nine sixteen-inch fifty caliber guns. They also carried twenty five-inch guns along with nearly one hundred and thirty 40mm and 20mm antiaircraft guns. 
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.

  - Update 02 Oct 19: Added boats and anchor chains. Updates to AA details.

  - Update 23 May 26: Added six variants, including USS Missouri WWII, USS New Jersey '68, two proposed versions of USS Kentucky, a proposed BBG variant, and USS Missouri '92.

Tested with PLA at .1mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

This is a model of a Hand Pump.Originally created with Blender 2.79 and textured using Substance Painter.
|| USAGE ||
This model is suitable for use in broadcast, advertising, design visualization, real-time, video game etc.
|| SPECS ||
This model contains 3 separate objects. This model contains 1432 polygons. This model contains Blender Cycles materials.
|| PRESENTATION IMAGES ||
All preview images are rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 3. Product is ready to render. Render setup is included.
|| TEXTURES ||
Textures have 8 bits per channel.

Boiler_Room.hdr 1024x512
|| GENERAL ||
Model is built to real-world scale(the unit system is metric). No third-party renderer or plug-ins needed.
|| INSTRUCTIONS ||
Put the files and textures into the same folder and start rendering.
|| ADDITIONAL NOTES ||
Other file formats. May be needed to reassign textures and will not render like the preview images. -FBX -OBJ-TBSCENE

description_text:
Overview
Relatively Lowpoly asset with basic textures created for use in a now defunct game, as featured in the preview images and video*.  Fort walls and towers are integratedas one mesh, though certain elements are modular (such as interior structures). This model is intended for quick, easy use; the gun windows were designed for use alongside my 4-iber long gun model; not included in this model but can be found here: https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/military/gun/4ib-naval-long-gun
PLEASE NOTE: This is NOT a fully modular model, as it was created to be a standalone asset for use in a pre-defined game. I do intend on releasing a refreshed, UE4 modular version shortly; so watch this space.
Features

  - Full set of UV maps and pre-rigged doorways (warning: some of the maps are fairly large due to the planked nature of the walls)

  - All towers and buildings are fully explorable

  - Wood planking is mostly indivdual, meaning light penetrates through the gaps as it would realistically with this type of building

  - Battle-damaged section; this fortification has seen use (section can be fairly easily replaced with clean section if desired)

  - Basic texturing means this should slip nicely into most workflows, even PBR with only a little extra work. Colour and bump included but be aware these are not of the highest resolution and I'd recommend replacing if possible.

History
This fictional fortress is loosely based upon the 18th-century Russian forest fort design, representing a 'Bandit' fortress. Intended for use in a now defunct Age of Sail game set in the Carribbean, it was commisioned alongside a few other basic low-poly models which I hope to get uploaded as well at some point.
*Please note that this sale is only for the fortess itself. Surrounding game environment is NOT included.

winchester m12 old 
- [ USAGE ]
  - A low-poly 3d model that can used for games,VR,AR

  - I also have a super realistic,high res,high poly for it for realistic render and close shots in my store, please check my store and have a look

  - .fbx, .obj, .stl, .collada formates, each in separate RAR

  - Unity 5 stabdard metallic  including  [AlbedoTransparency, Normal, MetallicSmoothness, Emission]

  - unreal engine 4 (packed)  including  [BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, normal,  Emissive]

  - tris: 3712 

  - Vertices: 2012

  - [TEXTURES ]

  - BPR realistic textures

  - the texture are in 4k and you can ask for other resolution [1-8k].

  - all textures are in .png format

  - you can ask for an other texture maps or formats or resolution (1-8k)

- [ GENERAL ]
  - ready to be rigged and animated

  - Clean and optimized topology is used for maximum polygon efficiency,mostly quads , no [n-ngons ,double faces, flipped faces, overlapping faces, inverted normals or stray vertices].

  - the exported mesh formats are the base mesh without triangulation and ready to be triangulated

  - All preview images are raw renders without any post production or editing and rendered using cycles renderer of blender 2.8

  - No uvs are mirrored (non-ovelapping)

  - the holes of the barrel cover are textured using opacity map not modeled to preserve low poly count

  - Model is built to real-world scale

  - Model Dimensions: 1.21m x 0.0625m x 0.254m

  - This model contains 11 objects with one UV-map, collected in one group

  - All  objects and textures  are named appropriately

  - No third-party renderer or plug-ins

  - Normal map was baked from a high poly model to provide great detail while minimizing the polygon count. Hand painted realistic textures created in substance painter

  - Model unwrapped and packed manually to make most efficient use of the UV space

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

- If you have any questions or any change , please feel free to  contact me  i'll what i can do

description_text:
Nefertiti was an Egyptian queen and the Great Royal Wife of Akhenaten, an Egyptian Pharaoh. Nefertiti and her husband were known for a religious revolution, in which they worshipped one god only, Aten, or the sun disc. With her husband, she reigned at what was arguably the wealthiestperiod of Ancient Egyptian history .
A German archaeological team led by Ludwig Borchardt discovered the bust in 1912 in Thutmose's workshop.The Nefertiti bust has become a cultural symbol of Berlin as well as ancient Egypt. It has also been the subject of an intense argument between Egypt and Germany over Egyptian demands for its repatriation, which began in 1924 once the bust was first displayed to the public. Egyptian inspectors were not shown the actual bust before they let it out of the country.

A variant of the German Bf 109, the Bf 109 Zwilling was an experimental aircraft that was built but never used during WWII. It was essentially two Bf 109 fuselages joined together by a center wing. Model is split into 4 linked objects- the body, the landing gear, the left prop, and the right prop. description_text:
Totem poles serve as important illustrations of family lineage and the cultural heritage of the Native peoples in the islands and coastal areas of North America's Pacific Northwest, especially British Columbia, Canada, and coastal areas of Washington and southeastern Alaska in the United States. Families of traditional carvers come from the Haida, Tlingit, Tsimshian, Kwakwaka’wakw (Kwakiutl), Nuxalk (Bella Coola), and Nuu-chah-nulth (Nootka), among others.[2][3] The poles are typically carved from the highly rot-resistant trunks of Thuja plicata trees (popularly known as giant cedar or western redcedar), which eventually decay in the moist, rainy climate of the coastal Pacific Northwest. Because of the region's climate and the nature of the materials used to make the poles, few examples carved before 1900 remain. Noteworthy examples, some dating as far back as 1880, include those at the Royal British Columbia Museum in Victoria, the Museum of Anthropology at UBC in Vancouver, the Canadian Museum of History in Gatineau, and the Totem Heritage Center in Ketchikan, Alaska.
Totem poles are the largest, but not the only, objects that coastal Pacific Northwest natives use to depict spiritual reverence, family legends, sacred beings and culturally important animals, people, or historical events. The freestanding poles seen by the region's first European explorers were likely preceded by a long history of decorative carving. Stylistic features of these poles were borrowed from earlier, smaller prototypes, or from the interior support posts of house beams.[4][5]
Although 18th-century accounts of European explorers traveling along the coast indicate that decorated interior and exterior house posts existed prior to 1800, the posts were smaller and fewer in number than in subsequent decades. Prior to the 19th century, the lack of efficient carving tools, along with sufficient wealth and leisure time to devote to the craft, delayed the development of elaborately carved, freestanding poles.[6] Before iron and steel arrived in the area, Natives used tools made of stone, shells, or beaver teeth for carving. The process was slow and laborious; axes were unknown. By the late eighteenth century, the use of metal cutting tools enabled more complex carvings and increased production of totem poles.[4] The tall monumental poles appearing in front of native homes in coastal villages probably did not appear until after the beginning of the nineteenth century.[6]
Eddie Malin has proposed that totem poles progressed from house posts, funerary containers, and memorial markers into symbols of clan and family wealth and prestige. He argues that the Haida people of the islands of Haida Gwaii originated carving of the poles, and that the practice spread outward to the Tsimshian and Tlingit, and then down the coast to the indigenous people of British Columbia and northern Washington.[7] Malin's theory is supported by the photographic documentation of the Pacific Northwest coast's cultural history and the more sophisticated designs of the Haida poles.
Accounts from the 1700s describe and illustrate carved poles and timber homes along the coast of the Pacific Northwest.[8][9] By the early nineteenth century, widespread importation of iron and steel tools from Great Britain, the United States, and elsewhere led to easier and more rapid production of carved wooden goods, including poles.[10]

It was the second of two ships in the Minas Geraes class, and was named after the state of São Paulo. São Paulo was launched on 19 April 1909 and commissioned on 12 July 1910. Soon after, it was involved in the Revolt of the Lash (Revolta de Chibata), in which crews on four Brazilian warships mutinied over poor pay and harsh punishments for even minor offenses. After entering the First World War, Brazil offered to send São Paulo and its sister Minas Geraes to Britain for service with the Grand Fleet, but Britain declined.
She was on active duty until 1951, when she was disembodied. It sank in the Atlantic Ocean, on the way to demolition, in the same year.

Note:  Verticy and Face counts are with subsurf
This model Consists of lots of detail and a Gipsy III engine. The gauge textures were costum made in PS. This model uses Subsurf modifiers for most of it so it can be converted to a lower or high poly count as desired. I did my best to add a lot of the fine details such as the control lines, rigging, wing root mounts, and all the nuts and bolts that go allong with those items. All the control surfaces and cowling parts are seperated but not rigged. 
The de Havilland DH.82 Tiger Moth is a 1930s British biplane designed by Geoffrey de Havilland and built by the de Havilland Aircraft Company. It was operated by the Royal Air Force (RAF) and many other operators as a primary trainer aircraft. In addition to the type's principal use for ab-initio training, the Second World War saw RAF Tiger Moths operating in other capacities, including maritime surveillance and defensive anti-invasion preparations; some aircraft were even outfitted to function as armed light bombers.
-Wikipidia

description_text:
This kit is a modular Arabian fortress inspired by Arab and Indian architecture from the Medieval Ages. The model is completely modular based around an 8 point system, so the fortress can be assembled in any number of different configurations, with each tower acting as an 8 point hub for the different wall and tower sections. 
Included are a wall gate section, a wall section, a tower wall section, a tower wall with door section, and an onion dome roof for the towers. Each component is grouped, for ease of use. It is very easy and simple to snap together a fortress of any complexity from these pieces, and I've included a sample fortress as the main model in the scene. 
The textures are photorealistic high quality images, embedded in the sketchup file. The model can be exported in any configuration to any format you desire, should you need it. The meshes are optimized and cleaned, and all faces are correctly oriented.

description_text:
George Frideric Handel 23 February 1685 – 14 April 1759. Was a German-born Baroque composer becoming well known for his operas, oratorios, anthems, concerti grossi and organ concertos. Handel received his training in Halle and worked as a composer in Hamburg and Italy before settling in London in 1712, where he spent the bulk of his career and became a naturalised British subject in 1727.He was strongly influenced both by the middle-German polyphonic choral tradition and by composers of the Italian Baroque. After his success with Messiah (1742) he never composed an Italian opera again. His orchestral Water Music, and Music for the Royal Fireworks remain steadfastly popular.Almost blind, he died in 1759, a respected and rich man, and was given a statefuneral at Westminster Abbey.

description_text:
Sir Winston Leonard Spencer-Churchill (30 November 1874 – 24 January 1965) was a British statesman who was the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1940to 1945 and again from 1951 to 1955. Churchill was also an officer in the British Army, a non-academic historian, and a writer (as Winston S. Churchill). He won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1953 for his overall, lifetime body of work. In 1963, he was the first of only eight people to be made an honorarycitizen of the United States.He then briefly resumed active army service on the Western Front as commander of the 6th Battalion of the Royal Scots Fusiliers. He returned to government underLloyd George as Minister of Munitions, Secretary of State for War, Secretary of State for Air, then Secretary of State for the Colonies. After two years out of Parliament, he served as Chancellor of the Exchequer in Baldwin's Conservative government of 1924–1929, controversially returning the pound sterling in1925 to the gold standard at its pre-war parity, a move widely seen as creating deflationary pressure on the UK economy.
Textured and render with 3D Studio MAx 8 and Mental Ray
textures and materials are included into each archive, just unzip and render.
Available in following format: Obj, Max8,Fbx,Stl
The model is print ready. Size : 5,4 x 6,7 x 11,9 cm

description_text:
About building:
The church of Saint Cyriakus is a medieval church in Gernrode, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany. It is one of the few surviving examples of Ottonian architecture, built in 959/960-965 by Margrave Gero, although it was restored in the 19th century. From its foundation until 1614 this church was the collegiate church of the abbey of Gernrode, also founded by Margrave Gero. The church and the abbey became Protestant in the mid-sixteenth century, and the church is now used by the Protestant community of Gernrode.
About model:

  - An exterior of St. Cyriakus church

  - Created and inspected in Blender 2.91

  - Fully textured and unwrapped

  - 4k textures

  - All objects, materials and textures are named properly

  - Plugins are not used

  - Lights and camera set

description_text: A Juish grave with hardly visible inscriptions. Found in Lithuania, Zapyskis graveyard. One standing gravestone and one lying down, collapsed among dry autumn leaves and pine tree needles. Model acquired using photogrammetry, therefore quite nice textures obtained. Manual retopo was performed, quad and tri mesh. 8k textures include color, AO, Normal Maps. derivative map - bump / cavity / roughness. For metalness black or 0 value should be used, there are no metallic / conductive parts in this model.  additionally included normal map with lettering removed. Suitable for historical, scientific or horror scenarios.

description_text: The shield was the most common means of defence. The sagas specifically mention linden wood for shield construction, although finds from graves show mostly other timbers, such as fir, alder and poplar with steel or iron shield boss. These timbers are not very dense and are light in the hand. They are also not inclined to split, unlike oak. Also, the fibres of the timber bind around blades preventing the blade from cutting any deeper unless a lot more pressure is applied. In conjunction with stronger wood, Vikings often reinforced their shields with leather or, occasionally, iron around the rim.[2] Round shields seem to have varied in size from around 45–120 centimetres (18–47 in) in diameter but 75–90 centimetres (30–35 in) is by far the most common......

description_text:
This Antique Fireplace model is low poly and includes the FREE animated 'Flaming Pear' shown in the demos. It's poly/vertices counts are P=3024, V=1514. 
A video clip demonstrating 'Flaming Pear' animation can be viewed on Youtube - http://youtu.be/nQvDHdQE2CA 
The Antique Fireplace model and logs are UV mapped in 2048 X 2048 pixels. Color, gloss, displacement and normal maps are provided. The log cradle model is finished in a near-black color and is not UV mapped.  The 'Flaming Pear'is video textured. A PNG image sequence with alpha channels and a GIF animation are provided, in the event that your software does not accept video texturing.
In pre-release testing, 3DS Max accepted video texturing with alpha channel of both FBX and DAE 'Flaming Pear' animation, but dropped deformers. In Maya, new material nodes must be created as either Movie or File type with image sequence. Maya and 3DS Max import AntiqueFireplace01.fbx with nmap, but do not import  AntiqueFireplace01.dae or fireplace02.obj with nmap. The AntiqueFireplace01.fbx imports into Unreal Engine 4 without problems and it is recommended to use the Particle Fire, rather than the included 'Flaming Pear' in Unreal Engine 4. However, the 'Flaming Pear' can be used with Movie media and texture coordinate nodes in a material.
Uploading required individual packaging of assets. Files included in the 9 ZIP files should be unpacked to the following folders for best results:...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\AntiqueFireplace\AntiqueFireplace01.daeAntiqueFireplace01.fbxfireplace02.mtlfireplace02.objfireplace02_default_disp.pngfireplace02_default_disp.tifffireplace02_default_gloss.pngfireplace02_default_nmap.pngfireplace02c_default_color.png...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\FlamingPear\FireLoop.aviFlamingPear.daeFlamingPear.fbxFlamingPear.mtlFlamingPear.obj...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\LogCrade\logcradle1.mtllogcradle1.obj...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\Logs\log2.mtllog2.objlog2_Texture_0_color.pnglog2_Texture_0_disp.tifflog2_Texture_0_disp.pnglog2_Texture_0_nmap.png...\AntiqueFireplace01\Movie\FireLoop (1).aviFireLoop (2).aviFireLoop (2).gifFireLoop.aviFireLoop2.avi...\AntiqueFireplace01\SourceImages\FireLoopImgs\FireLoopAlpha000.png - FireLoopAlpha313.png

description_text:
Sofa and armchair set
Are you looking for models into your architectural vizualisation? This set will look awesome in your render and you don't have to spend any time preparing it as it is ready-to-render. It consists of one sofa, one armchair, a lamp, glass table and tea set.
Technical info
Everything was done using Blender and Cycles rendering engine.Sofa and armchair are with leather material, table is made of glass, tea set has procedural clay material and plate is wooden. Everything is sorted, properly named, in the real-world-scale.No Subdivision: 22 598 Verts., 22 862 Faces, 44 796 Tris.Subd. turned on (Used for renders): 363 247 Verts., 362 958 Faces, 725 788 Tris.
Sorting of models
Models are placed close to centerModels are true-to-scaleLogicaly namedModels are sorted into groups
Appending models
Open your own .blendGo to File > AppendGo into models/groupsSelect model/group you want to append
Materials
Materials are leather, glass, wood, clay metal.There are two kinds of leather, but they differ only in color which is determined using color ramp. Color texture is turned into black/white and using color ramp you may do in any color you want. There are difuse, normal and spec textures included. The specularity map is heavily modified in node editor, but all you care about is the color ramp.Metal material is just basic - mixed difuse and glossy.Wood is mixed difuse and glossy using pointiess and with normal map applied.Clay is made of two difuse shaders mixed using pointiness and with bump generated using noise texture.Properly named
